newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 4.88 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 4.88 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 182-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 4.88 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
This compares with six-month HIBOR of 5.74038 percent at 0300 GMT and the average accepted yield of 4.75 percent at the previous tender on December 3.
Bids for the HK$1 billion issue totalled HK$3.77 billion against HK$2.54 billion in the last tender.
The average accepted yield of 91-day bills was 4.62 percent, compared with three-month HIBOR of 5.63942 percent and the average accepted yield of 4.61 percent at the tender last week.
Bids for the HK$2 billion issue fell to HK$5.13 billion from HK$7.11 billion at the pervious tender.
